findings.passage: For decades, Democrats have been focused on opening the process up and making sure every eligible citizen can participate. What President Trump is proposing moves in the opposite direction by adding new hurdles and making it harder to register and vote. Why? Because Republicans feel they have to cheat to win. Well, I have news for President Trump: we are not going to walk back the progress we've made on voting rights – not now, not ever.
findings.note: Quote from his press release on a New Brunswick voting rights roundtable. The release says he outlined how the SAVE America Act and executive actions on mail-in voting would end online and mail-in registration, require proof of citizenship and add federal authority over state-run elections.
